examples.en: A colorful feather fell from the bird's wing.
examples.zh: 一根彩色的羽毛從鳥的翅膀上掉下來。

examples.en: She decorated her hat with a long feather.
examples.zh: 她用一根長長的羽毛裝飾帽子。

examples.en: The pillow is filled with soft feathers from ducks.
examples.zh: 這個枕頭裡填滿了柔軟的鴨毛。

examples.en: The young fighter trained hard every morning before school.
examples.zh: 這位年輕的選手每天早上上學前都努力訓練。

examples.en: She is a fighter who never gives up on her dreams.
examples.zh: 她是個永不放棄夢想的奮鬥者。

examples.en: Two fighter jets flew over the stadium during the ceremony.
examples.zh: 典禮期間有兩架戰鬥機飛越體育場上空。

examples.en: We watched the fireworks from the roof of the hotel.
examples.zh: 我們從飯店的屋頂觀賞煙火。

examples.en: The children were excited about the fireworks at the festival.
examples.zh: 孩子們對慶典上的煙火感到很興奮。

examples.en: The city holds a large fireworks display on New Year's Eve.
examples.zh: 這座城市在跨年夜舉辦盛大的煙火表演。

examples.en: He held the coin tightly in his fist.
examples.zh: 他把硬幣緊緊握在拳頭裡。

examples.en: The baby opened and closed her tiny fist.
examples.zh: 寶寶把她小小的拳頭張開又握緊。

examples.en: The teacher raised a fist to show strong support.
examples.zh: 老師舉起拳頭表達強力的支持。

examples.en: The candle flame moved gently in the breeze.
examples.zh: 燭火在微風中輕輕搖曳。

examples.en: Firefighters rushed to put out the flames in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 消防員衝去撲滅廚房裡的火焰。

examples.en: Please turn down the flame so the soup does not burn.
examples.zh: 請把火關小一點，湯才不會燒焦。

examples.en: The dry wood flamed brightly in the fireplace.
examples.zh: 乾木頭在壁爐裡燒得很旺。

examples.en: Her face flamed with embarrassment when she forgot her lines.
examples.zh: 她忘詞時，臉羞得通紅。

examples.en: The sky flamed orange as the sun went down.
examples.zh: 太陽下山時，天空染成一片橘紅。

examples.en: A flash of lightning lit up the whole street.
examples.zh: 一道閃電照亮了整條街。

examples.en: Turn off the flash when you take photos in the museum.
examples.zh: 在博物館拍照時請關掉閃光燈。

examples.en: The news spread across the school in a flash.
examples.zh: 這個消息一瞬間就傳遍了學校。

examples.en: The warning light flashed red on the dashboard.
examples.zh: 儀表板上的警示燈閃著紅光。

examples.en: A smile flashed across her face when she saw us.
examples.zh: 她看到我們時，臉上閃過一抹微笑。

examples.en: The train flashed past the station without stopping.
examples.zh: 火車沒有停靠，呼嘯著駛過車站。

examples.en: This ice cream comes in twelve different flavors.
examples.zh: 這種冰淇淋有十二種不同的口味。

examples.en: Fresh herbs add a lot of flavor to the soup.
examples.zh: 新鮮香草為這道湯增添了許多風味。

examples.en: The tea served at this restaurant has a rich, distinctive flavor.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳供應的茶具有濃郁而獨特的風味。

examples.en: She flavored the cake with lemon and vanilla.
examples.zh: 她用檸檬和香草為蛋糕調味。

examples.en: Mom flavors the rice with a little ginger.
examples.zh: 媽媽用一點薑為米飯調味。

examples.en: You can flavor the tea with honey if you like.
examples.zh: 如果你喜歡，可以用蜂蜜為茶調味。

examples.en: The flesh of this fish is soft and white.
examples.zh: 這種魚的肉質柔軟潔白。

examples.en: Cut the fruit open and scoop out the sweet flesh.
examples.zh: 把水果切開，舀出甜甜的果肉。

examples.en: The doctor checked the flesh around the wound.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查了傷口周圍的皮肉。

examples.en: Small boats float on the calm lake.
examples.zh: 小船漂浮在平靜的湖面上。

examples.en: A balloon floated up into the sky.
examples.zh: 一顆氣球飄上了天空。

examples.en: Wood can float because it is lighter than water.
examples.zh: 木頭比水輕，所以能浮在水上。

examples.en: The fisherman watched his float move on the water.
examples.zh: 漁夫看著他的浮標在水面上移動。

examples.en: Each class built a colorful float for the parade.
examples.zh: 每個班級都為遊行做了一輛彩色花車。

examples.en: Beginners hold a float to support themselves while learning to swim.
examples.zh: 初學者學游泳時會拿著浮板支撐身體。

examples.en: A flock of birds flew over the field.
examples.zh: 一群鳥飛過田野。

examples.en: The shepherd leads his flock up the hill every morning.
examples.zh: 牧羊人每天早上帶著羊群上山。

examples.en: We saw a large flock of geese by the river.
examples.zh: 我們在河邊看到一大群鵝。

examples.en: Tourists flock to the beach in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天遊客成群湧向海灘。

examples.en: Fans flocked to the shop to buy the new album.
examples.zh: 粉絲們湧進店裡買新專輯。

examples.en: People flock to the night market on weekends.
examples.zh: 週末人們都湧向夜市。

examples.en: The heavy rain caused a flood in the small town.
examples.zh: 大雨在小鎮造成了水災。

examples.en: Many families lost their homes in the flood.
examples.zh: 許多家庭在洪水中失去了家園。

examples.en: The government built walls to protect the village from floods.
examples.zh: 政府築起圍牆保護村莊免受洪水侵襲。

examples.en: The river flooded the streets last night.
examples.zh: 河水昨晚淹沒了街道。

examples.en: Letters of thanks flooded the school office.
examples.zh: 感謝信如潮水般湧入學校辦公室。

examples.en: The bathroom flooded because the pipe broke.
examples.zh: 水管破裂，浴室淹水了。

examples.en: Please fold the letter and put it in the envelope.
examples.zh: 請把信摺好放進信封。

examples.en: She folded her arms and waited for an answer.
examples.zh: 她雙手交叉在胸前，等待答覆。

examples.en: He folded the map and slipped it into his bag.
examples.zh: 他把地圖摺起來，塞進包包裡。

examples.en: There is a deep fold in the middle of the paper.
examples.zh: 這張紙中間有一道很深的摺痕。

examples.en: The cat slept in the fold of the blanket.
examples.zh: 貓睡在毯子的摺層裡。

examples.en: Iron the shirt carefully along each fold.
examples.zh: 沿著每一道摺痕小心地熨燙襯衫。

examples.en: The singer has millions of followers online.
examples.zh: 這位歌手在網路上有數百萬名粉絲。

examples.en: She is a loyal follower of the local baseball team.
examples.zh: 她是當地棒球隊的忠實球迷。

examples.en: The leader thanked every follower for the support.
examples.zh: 領袖感謝每一位追隨者的支持。

examples.en: My little brother is fond of dinosaurs.
examples.zh: 我弟弟很喜歡恐龍。

examples.en: She has fond memories of her grandmother's kitchen.
examples.zh: 她對外婆的廚房有著溫馨的回憶。

examples.en: The teacher is very fond of her students.
examples.zh: 老師非常疼愛她的學生。

examples.en: I will remember this trip with my family forever.
examples.zh: 我會永遠記得這趟與家人一起的旅行。

examples.en: The old bridge will not last forever.
examples.zh: 這座老橋不可能永遠撐下去。

examples.en: They promised to stay friends forever after finishing high school.
examples.zh: 他們承諾高中畢業後也要永遠做朋友。

examples.en: He made a fortune by selling used books online.
examples.zh: 他在網路上賣二手書賺了一大筆錢。

examples.en: We had the good fortune to meet a kind guide.
examples.zh: 我們很幸運遇到一位親切的導遊。

examples.en: She went to the temple to have her fortune told.
examples.zh: 她去廟裡算命。

examples.en: Children played near the fountain in the park.
examples.zh: 孩子們在公園的噴泉旁玩耍。

examples.en: We took photos in front of the beautiful fountain.
examples.zh: 我們在美麗的噴泉前拍照。

examples.en: The fountain stops running at ten o'clock at night.
examples.zh: 噴泉在晚上十點就會停止噴水。

examples.en: Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius under normal atmospheric pressure.
examples.zh: 在正常大氣壓力下，水會在攝氏零度結冰。

examples.en: You can freeze the extra soup for next week.
examples.zh: 你可以把多的湯冷凍起來留到下週。

examples.en: We almost froze while waiting for the bus.
examples.zh: 我們等公車時差點被凍僵。

examples.en: A hard freeze last night damaged the vegetables.
examples.zh: 昨晚的嚴寒凍傷了蔬菜。

examples.en: The company announced a freeze on new hiring.
examples.zh: 公司宣布凍結招募新人。

examples.en: There was a deep freeze across the northern cities.
examples.zh: 北方城市出現了一波嚴寒。

examples.en: He is a frequent visitor to the school library.
examples.zh: 他是學校圖書館的常客。

examples.en: Frequent rain made our walking tour of the island difficult.
examples.zh: 頻繁的降雨讓我們徒步遊覽這座島嶼時困難重重。

examples.en: There are frequent buses between the two cities.
examples.zh: 兩個城市之間的公車班次很密集。

examples.en: Many students frequent the bookstore near the school.
examples.zh: 許多學生常去學校附近的書店。

examples.en: She frequents that cafe on weekends to read and relax.
examples.zh: 她週末常去那家咖啡廳閱讀、放鬆。

examples.en: Tourists frequent this beach in summer because the water is clear.
examples.zh: 夏天遊客常到這片海灘，因為那裡的海水清澈。

examples.en: The loud noise gave me a terrible fright.
examples.zh: 那聲巨響把我嚇了一大跳。

examples.en: The little girl cried out in fright.
examples.zh: 小女孩驚嚇得大叫起來。

examples.en: He recovered from the fright after a cup of tea.
examples.zh: 他喝了杯茶後就從驚嚇中恢復了。

examples.en: The car stopped because it ran out of fuel.
examples.zh: 車子因為沒油而停了下來。

examples.en: Fuel prices rose again this month, increasing costs for drivers.
examples.zh: 這個月燃料價格又上漲了，增加了駕駛人的開銷。

examples.en: Wood is still used as fuel in some villages.
examples.zh: 有些村莊仍然用木柴當燃料。

examples.en: Workers fueled the plane before takeoff while passengers waited inside the terminal.
examples.zh: 工作人員在起飛前為飛機加油，乘客則在航廈內等候。

examples.en: Rumors fueled the fear among the students.
examples.zh: 謠言助長了學生之間的恐慌。

examples.en: A good breakfast will fuel you for the whole morning.
examples.zh: 一頓豐盛的早餐能讓你一整個早上充滿活力。

examples.en: The school set up a fund to help poor students.
examples.zh: 學校設立了一筆基金來幫助清寒學生。

examples.en: We need more funds to finish the project.
examples.zh: 我們需要更多資金來完成這個專案。

examples.en: She donated money to the relief fund.
examples.zh: 她捐錢給救災基金。

examples.en: The government will fund the new library.
examples.zh: 政府將出資興建新圖書館。

examples.en: Local businesses funded the school trip to the science museum.
examples.zh: 當地商家資助了這次前往科學博物館的校外旅行。

examples.en: The research was funded by a large company.
examples.zh: 這項研究由一家大公司出資。

examples.en: The cat has soft white fur and bright green eyes.
examples.zh: 這隻貓有柔軟的白色皮毛和明亮的綠眼睛。

examples.en: Her winter coat has a fur collar to keep her neck warm.
examples.zh: 她的冬季外套有毛皮領子，能讓頸部保暖。

examples.en: Brush the dog's fur every day to keep it clean.
examples.zh: 每天幫狗梳毛，讓牠保持乾淨。

examples.en: We bought a gallon of milk at the supermarket.
examples.zh: 我們在超市買了一加侖的牛奶。

examples.en: The tank holds about ten gallons of water.
examples.zh: 這個水槽大約能裝十加侖的水。

examples.en: A gallon of paint is enough for two rooms.
examples.zh: 一加侖的油漆足夠粉刷兩個房間。

examples.en: He lost his savings when he gambled at the casino.
examples.zh: 他在賭場賭博輸光了積蓄。

examples.en: The company gambled on a new product and won.
examples.zh: 公司在一項新產品上冒險一搏，結果成功了。

examples.en: You should not gamble with your future.
examples.zh: 你不該拿自己的未來冒險。

examples.en: Starting a new business is always a gamble.
examples.zh: 創業總是一場冒險。

examples.en: The coach's gamble paid off in the final game.
examples.zh: 教練的冒險在決賽中得到了回報。

examples.en: Moving to a new city was a big gamble for them.
examples.zh: 搬到新城市對他們來說是一大賭注。

examples.en: The police arrested members of a gang last night.
examples.zh: 警方昨晚逮捕了幫派成員。

examples.en: A gang of kids played ball in the street.
examples.zh: 一群孩子在街上玩球。

examples.en: My old gang from school meets every summer.
examples.zh: 我學生時代的那群朋友每年夏天都會聚會。

examples.en: The cat slipped through a gap in the fence.
examples.zh: 貓從籬笆的縫隙鑽了過去。

examples.en: There is a big gap between the rich and the poor.
examples.zh: 貧富之間有很大的差距。

examples.en: I need to fill the gap in my resume.
examples.zh: 我必須補上履歷中的空白。

examples.en: She took a quick glance at her watch.
examples.zh: 她匆匆看了一眼手錶。

examples.en: At first glance, the room looked clean.
examples.zh: 乍看之下，房間很乾淨。

examples.en: He gave me a glance and walked away.
examples.zh: 他瞥了我一眼就走開了。

examples.en: He glanced at the clock during the meeting.
examples.zh: 他在會議中瞥了一眼時鐘。

examples.en: She glanced out the window and saw the rain.
examples.zh: 她瞥向窗外，看到下雨了。

examples.en: I only glanced through the newspaper this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上只是大略翻了翻報紙。

examples.en: Global warming is a serious problem that affects every country.
examples.zh: 全球暖化是影響每個國家的嚴重問題。

examples.en: The company has a global network of stores.
examples.zh: 這家公司在全球各地都有分店。

examples.en: The movie became a global success and attracted millions of viewers.
examples.zh: 這部電影在全球大受歡迎，吸引了數百萬名觀眾。

examples.en: The team returned home covered in glory.
examples.zh: 球隊榮耀滿身地回到家鄉。

examples.en: Everyone admired the glory of the sunrise.
examples.zh: 大家都讚嘆日出的壯麗。

examples.en: She worked hard for the glory of her school.
examples.zh: 她為了學校的榮譽努力不懈。

examples.en: The lamp glowed softly in the dark room.
examples.zh: 燈在昏暗的房間裡散發著柔和的光。

examples.en: Her cheeks glowed after she ran up the hill.
examples.zh: 她跑上山後，雙頰紅通通的。

examples.en: The little girl glowed with pride at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 小女孩在典禮上驕傲得容光煥發。

examples.en: The glow of the candle filled the room.
examples.zh: 燭光灑滿了整個房間。

examples.en: We saw a warm glow in the window.
examples.zh: 我們看見窗戶透出溫暖的光亮。

examples.en: A healthy glow came back to his face.
examples.zh: 他的臉上恢復了健康的紅潤。

examples.en: I do not like to listen to gossip at work.
examples.zh: 我不喜歡在工作時聽八卦。

examples.en: The magazine is full of gossip about movie stars.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌滿是電影明星的八卦。

examples.en: Don't believe the gossip you hear in the hallway.
examples.zh: 別相信你在走廊上聽到的閒話。

examples.en: They gossiped about their classmates after school.
examples.zh: 他們放學後聊起同學的八卦。

examples.en: Please don't gossip about your coworkers or spread rumors about them.
examples.zh: 請不要議論同事的私事，也不要散播關於他們的謠言。

examples.en: The neighbors gossip every time she comes home late.
examples.zh: 每次她晚歸，鄰居們就會議論紛紛。

examples.en: The governor spoke to reporters outside the building.
examples.zh: 州長在大樓外向記者發言。

examples.en: The governor of the state visited our school.
examples.zh: 州長來我們學校參訪。

examples.en: People voted for a new governor last Tuesday.
examples.zh: 人們上週二投票選出新任州長。

examples.en: He grabbed his umbrella and ran out the door.
examples.zh: 他抓起雨傘就衝出門去。

examples.en: Let's grab a quick lunch before the meeting.
examples.zh: 開會前我們隨便吃個午餐吧。

examples.en: She grabbed my arm to stop me from falling.
examples.zh: 她抓住我的手臂，讓我不會跌倒。

examples.en: The baby made a grab for the toy.
examples.zh: 寶寶伸手去抓那個玩具。

examples.en: With a quick grab, he caught the falling cup.
examples.zh: 他迅速一抓，接住了掉落的杯子。

examples.en: The bag was easy to reach, so I made a grab for it.
examples.zh: 那個袋子很容易拿到，我就伸手一抓。

examples.en: She will graduate from university next June.
examples.zh: 她明年六月將從大學畢業。

examples.en: My brother graduated from high school last year.
examples.zh: 我哥哥去年從高中畢業。

examples.en: Most university students graduate at the age of twenty-two.
examples.zh: 大部分大學生在二十二歲時畢業。

examples.en: He is a graduate of National Taiwan University.
examples.zh: 他是國立台灣大學的畢業生。

examples.en: The company hires many fresh graduates each year.
examples.zh: 這家公司每年都會雇用許多應屆畢業生。

examples.en: The graduates threw their caps into the air.
examples.zh: 畢業生們把帽子拋向空中。

examples.en: The baby grasped my finger with her tiny hand.
examples.zh: 寶寶用小手抓住我的手指。

examples.en: He quickly grasped the main idea of the lesson.
examples.zh: 他很快就理解了這堂課的重點。

examples.en: She grasped the rope and pulled herself up.
examples.zh: 她抓緊繩子把自己拉上去。

examples.en: He has a good grasp of English grammar.
examples.zh: 他對英文文法有很好的掌握。

examples.en: The ball slipped out of my grasp.
examples.zh: 球從我的手中滑掉了。

examples.en: The explanation is beyond my grasp because it uses unfamiliar terms.
examples.zh: 這段解釋超出了我的理解範圍，因為其中使用了我不熟悉的術語。

examples.en: The farmer grows tomatoes in a greenhouse.
examples.zh: 農夫在溫室裡種番茄。

examples.en: It is always warm inside the greenhouse.
examples.zh: 溫室裡面總是很溫暖。

examples.en: We visited a greenhouse full of tropical flowers.
examples.zh: 我們參觀了一座種滿熱帶花卉的溫室。

examples.en: He had a big grin on his face.
examples.zh: 他臉上露出大大的笑容。

examples.en: She gave me a quick grin and waved.
examples.zh: 她對我咧嘴一笑並揮了揮手。

examples.en: A proud grin spread across the boy's face.
examples.zh: 男孩臉上浮現出得意的笑容。

examples.en: The kids grinned when they saw the cake.
examples.zh: 孩子們看到蛋糕就咧嘴笑了。

examples.en: He grinned at me from across the room.
examples.zh: 他從房間另一頭對我咧嘴而笑。

examples.en: She grinned happily after winning the prize.
examples.zh: 她得獎後開心地笑了。

examples.en: Mom does the grocery shopping every Saturday.
examples.zh: 媽媽每週六都會去採買食品雜貨。

examples.en: The grocery on the corner closes at ten.
examples.zh: 轉角的雜貨店十點關門。

examples.en: I put the groceries in the refrigerator.
examples.zh: 我把採買的食物放進冰箱。

examples.en: The students need guidance from their teachers.
examples.zh: 學生需要老師的指導。

examples.en: She offers career guidance to young people.
examples.zh: 她為年輕人提供職涯指導。

examples.en: With your guidance, I finished the project.
examples.zh: 在你的指導下，我完成了這個專案。

examples.en: Please do not chew gum in class.
examples.zh: 請不要在課堂上嚼口香糖。

examples.en: My gums hurt after I brushed too hard.
examples.zh: 我刷牙太用力，之後牙齦就痛了。

examples.en: He stuck a piece of gum under the desk.
examples.zh: 他把一塊口香糖黏在桌子下面。

examples.en: My hairdresser cut my hair very short.
examples.zh: 我的美髮師把我的頭髮剪得很短。

examples.en: She works as a hairdresser in a small salon.
examples.zh: 她在一家小沙龍當美髮師。

examples.en: I have an appointment with the hairdresser at three.
examples.zh: 我跟美髮師約了三點。

examples.en: Students walked quietly down the hallway while other classes were taking tests.
examples.zh: 其他班級正在考試時，學生們安靜地走過走廊。

examples.en: Leave your shoes in the hallway, please.
examples.zh: 請把鞋子放在玄關。

examples.en: The hallway was dark, so I turned on the light.
examples.zh: 走廊很暗，所以我打開了燈。

examples.en: She picked up a handful of nuts from the bowl.
examples.zh: 她從碗裡抓了一把堅果。

examples.en: Only a handful of students came to the meeting.
examples.zh: 只有少數學生來參加會議。

examples.en: He tossed a handful of rice into the pot.
examples.zh: 他把一把米丟進鍋裡。

examples.en: A small flashlight is handy when the power goes out.
examples.zh: 停電時，小手電筒很方便。

examples.en: Keep your phone handy in case I call.
examples.zh: 把手機放在手邊，以防我打電話給你。

examples.en: My father is handy with tools and repairs our furniture himself.
examples.zh: 我爸爸擅長使用工具，會自己修理家裡的家具。

examples.en: Many boats were waiting in the harbor.
examples.zh: 許多船停在港口等待。

examples.en: We had seafood by the harbor last night.
examples.zh: 我們昨晚在港邊吃海鮮。

examples.en: The ship entered the harbor at dawn.
examples.zh: 這艘船在黎明時進入港口。

examples.en: She harbored a hope of becoming a doctor.
examples.zh: 她心懷成為醫生的希望。

examples.en: He still harbors a grudge against his old friend.
examples.zh: 他仍對老朋友懷恨在心。

examples.en: Some old buildings harbor dust and insects.
examples.zh: 一些老建築裡藏著灰塵和蟲子。

examples.en: Smoking can do great harm to your health.
examples.zh: 吸菸會嚴重損害你的健康。

examples.en: There is no harm in asking for help.
examples.zh: 尋求協助並沒有什麼不好。

examples.en: The storm caused serious harm to the crops.
examples.zh: 暴風雨對農作物造成嚴重損害。

examples.en: Listening to loud music for hours can harm your ears.
examples.zh: 連續聽好幾個小時的大聲音樂可能會傷害你的耳朵。

examples.en: Pollution from nearby factories harms fish in the river.
examples.zh: 附近工廠造成的污染傷害了河裡的魚。

examples.en: The scandal harmed the company's reputation and caused it to lose customers.
examples.zh: 這起醜聞損害了公司的名聲，導致公司流失顧客。

examples.en: Too much sugar is harmful to your teeth.
examples.zh: 過多的糖對牙齒有害。

examples.en: Some chemicals are harmful to the environment.
examples.zh: 有些化學物質對環境有害。

examples.en: Strong sunlight can be harmful to your skin.
examples.zh: 強烈的陽光可能會傷害你的皮膚。

examples.en: This year's rice harvest was very good.
examples.zh: 今年的稻米收成非常好。

examples.en: The farmers celebrated the harvest with a big dinner.
examples.zh: 農夫們以盛大的晚餐慶祝豐收。

examples.en: Heavy rain reduced the corn harvest in this region.
examples.zh: 大雨使這個地區的玉米收成減少。

examples.en: They harvest the apples in October when the fruit is ripe.
examples.zh: 他們在十月蘋果成熟時採收。

examples.en: Farmers harvested the wheat by hand before modern machines became common.
examples.zh: 在現代機械普及之前，農夫們以手工收割小麥。

examples.en: We harvested enough vegetables for the winter.
examples.zh: 我們採收了足夠過冬的蔬菜。

examples.en: Don't make a hasty decision about your future.
examples.zh: 別對你的未來做出草率的決定。

examples.en: He left in a hasty manner without saying goodbye.
examples.zh: 他匆匆離開，連再見都沒說。

examples.en: A hasty answer may cause mistakes on the test.
examples.zh: 草率作答可能會讓考試出錯。
